summary: Register Odnoklassniki/OK as a Social Core provider with exact group binding, signed REST group-topic publication, released photo/video upload, bounded topic analytics and fail-closed ambiguous writes without Core changes.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound Account resolves one exact numeric OK GroupID; health, publication, status and analytics reject foreign group identities.
OAuth token and application-secret bytes remain Task-021 callback-scoped; media bytes are opened only from current Task-088 released references.
Task 045 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 045 consumes existing SocialPublisher, SocialPublicationStatusReader and SocialAnalyticsReader projections; frozen Connector/Runtime SDK-v1 roots and Core remain unchanged.
No migration is added; OK configuration and remote media/topic identifiers remain provider boundary data.

REST egress is fixed to api.ok.ru; dynamic upload URLs are HTTPS/443 and suffix-safe restricted to qualified OK upload authorities; request signatures are calculated from callback-scoped secrets and secret material is excluded from results/errors.
Only group text/image/video publication and bounded topic analytics are declared. User-wall/note, edit/delete, comments, native scheduling and advertising surfaces remain undeclared.
Task-020 remains canonical Content/Variant/Publication/audit owner; the provider returns only bounded group-bound remote publication IDs/status/analytics.
Remote IDs include exact GroupID; ambiguous write transport/5xx/system outcomes fail closed as write_outcome_unknown instead of blind retry.
Task 045 adds outbound OK REST/media-upload egress only and no inbound webhook surface.
Authentication, permission, rate-limit, missing-resource, media and availability failures are normalized without raw OK responses or credential bytes.
Suspend the OK connector account and revoke OAuth/application credentials to stop egress; no schema rollback is required.
Deterministic tests cover manifest parity, exact group health, REST signing, text/photo/video publication, status, analytics and write ambiguity; Task-064 passes all thirteen checks.
